name: Nkisi Binding
body:
Prerequisite(s): Nganga, Wisdom 13

Benefit(s): You can use your Nkisi to bind someone to a contract or agreement. By driving a nail into the Nkisi while stating the terms of the contract, you create a spiritual bond that enforces its terms. If the contract is broken, you instantly become aware of the breach, regardless of distance. Additionally, the offending party suffers a -2 penalty to all skill checks and saving throws, for a number of days equal to your Wisdom modifier.
